title: Google launches Tabletop, an experimental AI platform to build customizable, collaborative personal planning and coordination hubs, in beta via a waitlist (Jess Weatherbed/The Verge)
summary: Jess Weatherbed / The Verge: Google launches Tabletop, an experimental AI platform to build customizable, collaborative personal planning and coordination hubs, in beta via a waitlist — Tabletop provides customizable, collaborative spaces for all your personal planning needs.
